documents.title: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: draft guidance for initial price applicability year 2029 (illustrative)
documents.summary: CMS proposes how it will select drugs and run negotiations for 2029. It clarifies how the Medicare spend threshold is applied and asks for comments within 45 days.

documents.title: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: final guidance for initial price applicability year 2029 (illustrative)
documents.summary: CMS finalises the 2029 negotiation process. It confirms the data used to judge bona fide generic and biosimilar marketing.

documents.title: Federal Register notice: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program information collection (illustrative)
documents.summary: CMS updates the manufacturer data forms used during negotiation. Submission deadlines for selected drugs move by two weeks.

documents.title: GLOBE Model final rule: correcting amendment (illustrative)
documents.summary: Corrects technical errors in the GLOBE Model final rule. It restates the reference-country list and the covered Part B therapeutic categories.

documents.title: GUARD Model: updated model information (illustrative)
documents.summary: CMS publishes updated GUARD Model details for Part D drugs. It describes the first performance year and how the spend threshold is calculated.

documents.title: Implementing Regulation amending the joint clinical assessment procedure for medicinal products (illustrative)
documents.summary: Amends procedural rules for joint clinical assessments of medicinal products. It adjusts dossier timelines and how health technology developers are consulted.

documents.title: Joint scientific consultations: updated guidance for health technology developers (illustrative)
documents.summary: Updated guidance on requesting joint scientific consultations. It sets out the selection criteria and the next request periods.

documents.title: EU pharmaceutical legislation: Council compromise text, draft Regulation (illustrative)
documents.summary: New Council compromise text on the draft Regulation. It revises the application date and the transitional provisions for products authorised before it.

documents.title: EU pharmaceutical legislation: Council compromise text, draft Directive (illustrative)
documents.summary: New Council compromise text on the draft Directive. It changes the regulatory data protection periods and the conditions for extra market protection.
